# lettermint_project (Resource)

Manage a Lettermint project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lettermint_project" "application" {
  name                 = "Application"
  smtp_enabled         = true
  initial_routes       = "both"
  short_token          = false
  redact_email_content = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `initial_routes` (String) Routes created with the project.
- `redact_email_content` (Boolean) Whether Lettermint redacts stored email content.
- `short_token` (Boolean) Whether the create operation returns a short API token.
- `smtp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMTP sending is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token returned once when the project is created.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_route_id` (String) Default route ID.
- `id` (String) Lettermint resource ID.
- `token_generated_at` (String) Token generation time.
- `token_last_used_at` (String) Last token use time.
- `token_last_used_ip` (String) Last token use IP address.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.

The API returns `api_token` only when it creates the project. Store the value securely. An import cannot recover it.

## Import

```shell
terraform import lettermint_project.application 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
